report_name: NSA and ISASecure Partner on New OT Component Certification for National Security Systems

identities.name: National Security Agency
identities.description: A U.S. government agency partnering with ISASecure to develop the High Criticality Component Security Assurance (HCSA) certification for operational technology (OT) components used in National Security Systems (NSS).

identities.name: ISASecure
identities.description: A subsidiary of the International Society of Automation (ISA) collaborating with the NSA to create the HCSA certification scheme, which builds upon the ISA/IEC 62443 standard.

identities.name: International Society of Automation
identities.description: The parent organization of ISASecure, which develops the ISA/IEC 62443 series of standards for industrial automation and control systems security.

identities.name: U.S. National Security Systems
identities.description: High-stakes U.S. government systems for which the High Criticality Component Security Assurance (HCSA) OT component certification is being developed.

identities.name: Operational Technology Component Manufacturers
identities.description: Vendors of OT components, such as smart controllers, who will be affected by the new HCSA certification requirement to sell products for use in U.S. National Security Systems.
